masteryZone.q: What was the motto of the 2011 Census?
masteryZone.sol: The motto was 'Our Census, Our Future'.

masteryZone.q: In which year was the first synchronous census conducted in India?
masteryZone.sol: The first synchronous census was conducted in 1881 under Lord Ripon.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The year 1921 is known as the 'Year of the Great Divide' due to negative growth.
masteryZone.sol: True. 1921 recorded a negative growth rate of -0.31%.

masteryZone.q: Who was the Census Commissioner of India in 2011?
Which state has the highest population density?
masteryZone.sol: Bihar has the highest density at 1106 persons per sq km.

masteryZone.q: Which state has the highest proportion of rural population?
masteryZone.sol: Himachal Pradesh is 90% rural by proportion.

masteryZone.q: True or False: The national average population density in 2011 was 382.
masteryZone.sol: True. India's population density rose to 382 persons per sq km.

masteryZone.q: Which UT has the highest literacy rate in India?
masteryZone.sol: Lakshadweep has the highest literacy among UTs at 91.85%.

masteryZone.q: What is the population density of Uttar Pradesh?
masteryZone.sol: UP's population density is 829 persons per sq km.

masteryZone.q: What is the literacy rate of Uttar Pradesh?
True or False: UP's child sex ratio (902) is lower than its general sex ratio (912).
masteryZone.sol: True. UP's child sex ratio is 902, while general sex ratio is 912.

masteryZone.q: What is the gender gap in literacy rate in UP?
Which district of UP has the highest sex ratio?
masteryZone.sol: Jaunpur has the highest sex ratio in UP at 1024.

masteryZone.q: Which district of UP has the lowest literacy rate?
masteryZone.sol: Shravasti has the lowest literacy rate at 46.74%.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Prayagraj is the most populous district in Uttar Pradesh.
masteryZone.sol: True. Prayagraj is the most populous district with ~59.5 lakh people.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Sonbhadra has the highest density in UP.
masteryZone.sol: False. Sonbhadra has low density (270). Ghaziabad has the highest density (3971).
